mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE increasing by >0.2 percentage points in the last month) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 102.5) and an increase in unemployment (UNRATE > 4.2) signals an economic contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 102.5 and UNRATE > 4.2 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1450 (HOUST > 1450) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1450 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 102.0) signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in unemployment (UNRATE rising > 0.3pp in 1 month) signals immediate economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to panic selling.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A consumer spending level above 750,000 (RSAFS > 750,000) reflects robust household consumption, a key driver of corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 750,000 (over a 5-year rolling window).
